newsitem.title: GREECE: Bank of Greece drains 150 bln drs at 11.90 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Greece drains 150 bln drs at 11.90 pct.

text.p: The Bank of Greece drained 150 billion drachmas of 14-day funds at 11.90 percent in today's fixed interest rate tender, it said.
"Individual bids were satisfied pro rata on the basis of the ensuing allotment ratio of 80.95 percent," it said.
A pact of 200 billion drachmas for 14-day funds matured today so that a net amount of about 50 billion drachmas boosted the system's liquidity. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
